originalArtifact.scope: Every current test declaration and tagged SQL assertion across all represented stories; redundancy review, not a claim of new hosted execution or human sign-off.
methodology: Enumerated source declarations, fixtures, calls, assertion expressions and story/category mappings across all 224 test modules and 46 SQL suites.
Checked same-file assertion subsets, exact fixture parity, cross-file SQL privilege predicates and closest browser/integration overlaps.
Removed only proved subsets or identical schema guards. Distinct roles, failure injections, public layers, race cases and boundary inputs remain.
This is a complete structural screen with focused semantic proofs for candidates, not a mathematical proof that no further refactoring is possible.
originalArtifact.coverageVerification: PASS: full post-change npm run ci rerun; frontend and backend each have 100% statement, branch, line and function coverage with existing per-file thresholds unchanged. One earlier run had an unreproduced ECONNRESET in the unchanged work-queue test; no retries or test/application changes were introduced.
